parameters.query:
-- TODO: Replace with actual source HIS query
-- This is a template. Connect to your source HIS database.
-- Query should return active patients:
--   INPATIENT: all currently admitted
--   OUTPATIENT: today's checked-in/registered/arrived/active only
--   DAYCARE: today's active
--   EMERGENCY: today's active
SELECT
  mrn, uhid, patient_name, date_of_birth, gender, blood_group,
  mobile_number, care_setting, ward_name, bed_number, room_number,
  attending_consultant_id, consultant_name, admission_date,
  discharge_date, visit_number, encounter_id, patient_id,
  source_system, chief_complaint, primary_diagnosis
FROM active_patients_view
WHERE modified_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '2 minutes'

INSERT INTO bcp_active_patient (
  tenant_id, source_system, mrn, uhid, patient_name,
  date_of_birth, gender, blood_group, mobile_number,
  care_setting, ward_name, bed_number, room_number,
  attending_consultant_id, consultant_name, admission_date,
  discharge_date, visit_number, encounter_id, patient_id,
  chief_complaint, primary_diagnosis, is_active,
  business_date, last_synced_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $env.DEFAULT_TENANT_ID }}',
  '{{ $json.source_system }}',
  '{{ $json.mrn }}',
  '{{ $json.uhid }}',
  '{{ $json.patient_name }}',
  {{ $json.date_of_birth ? "'" + $json.date_of_birth + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.gender ? "'" + $json.gender + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.blood_group ? "'" + $json.blood_group + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.mobile_number ? "'" + $json.mobile_number + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $json.care_setting }}',
  {{ $json.ward_name ? "'" + $json.ward_name + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.bed_number ? "'" + $json.bed_number + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.room_number ? "'" + $json.room_number + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.attending_consultant_id ? "'" + $json.attending_consultant_id + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.consultant_name ? "'" + $json.consultant_name + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.admission_date ? "'" + $json.admission_date + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.discharge_date ? "'" + $json.discharge_date + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $json.visit_number }}',
  {{ $json.encounter_id ? "'" + $json.encounter_id + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.patient_id ? "'" + $json.patient_id + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.chief_complaint ? "'" + $json.chief_complaint + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.primary_diagnosis ? "'" + $json.primary_diagnosis + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  true,
  CURRENT_DATE,
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, source_system, mrn, visit_number)
DO UPDATE SET
  patient_name = EXCLUDED.patient_name,
  ward_name = EXCLUDED.ward_name,
  bed_number = EXCLUDED.bed_number,
  room_number = EXCLUDED.room_number,
  consultant_name = EXCLUDED.consultant_name,
  discharge_date = EXCLUDED.discharge_date,
  chief_complaint = EXCLUDED.chief_complaint,
  primary_diagnosis = EXCLUDED.primary_diagnosis,
  is_active = true,
  last_synced_at = NOW();

UPDATE bcp_sync_status SET
  sync_status = 'SUCCESS',
  last_sync_completed_at = NOW(),
  last_success_at = NOW(),
  records_synced = {{ $items().length }},
  error_message = NULL
WHERE sync_component = 'ACTIVE_PATIENT'
  AND tenant_id = '{{ $env.DEFAULT_TENANT_ID }}';
